## Game name
<!-- What's the game called? -->

## New game or existing game?
<!-- New game, or adding to an existing one? If existing, which file? -->

## Theme & setting
<!-- What's the world/vibe? (e.g. Hot Wheels racing, outer space, dinosaurs, underwater) -->

## Characters / players
<!-- Who are the players or characters? Any names or specific look? -->

## Player mode
<!-- [ ] 1-player  [ ] 2-player  [ ] vs CPU -->

## Core mechanic
<!-- What does the player actually DO? (e.g. dodge obstacles, shoot enemies, hit a ball back and forth, race to the finish) -->

## Win condition / scoring
<!-- How do you win? How is score tracked? (e.g. first to 5 goals, survive 3 waves, beat the clock) -->

## Levels or progression (optional)
<!-- Any levels, difficulty ramp, or campaign structure? -->

## Visual style notes (optional)
<!-- Any specific colors, characters, sprites, or effects beyond the default neon pixel look? -->

## Audio notes (optional)
<!-- Any specific sound effects or music mood? (all audio is chip-tune via Web Audio API) -->

## Inspiration / references (optional)
<!-- Any games, movies, or shows this is based on or inspired by? -->

## Claude design outputs (optional)
<!-- Link to any Claude-generated designs, mockups, or docs that inform this game. -->
